paragraphs: ICD - International Business School is a French Grande École de Commerce founded in 1980 and based in Paris, Lyon, and Toulouse. It is part of Groupe IGENSIA Education (formerly Groupe IGS), one of the largest private higher education groups in France. The school's Programme Grande École delivers a Bac+5 Diplôme Visé Grade de Master, recognised by the French Ministry of Higher Education and labelled by the Conférence des Grandes Écoles (CGE).

ICD's flagship Bachelor en Sciences du Management runs over three years with specialisation tracks in Business Development, Event Management, and Marketing & AI. The Mastère portfolio covers International Business Development, Ingénieur d'Affaires, Stratégies Digitales, Achats, Stratégies Commerciales du Luxe, and Banque — combining classroom training with mandatory work-study (alternance) periods at partner companies.

International mobility is at the heart of the curriculum: the school works with more than 80 partner universities worldwide for semester exchanges, and offers a dedicated Intercultural Management Semester (SMI) spanning destinations from Asia to Canada. More than 100 Erasmus+ scholarships are awarded each year to ICD students for study abroad and international internships.

The Paris campus Le Vivier is part of the IGENSIA Education multi-school campus in the 10th arrondissement, near Gare de l'Est. International candidates are admitted through the Concours ICD or direct application with IELTS / TOEFL evidence; English-taught programmes include the Bachelor International Business & Marketing, the Mastère International Business Development, and the Executive DBA delivered jointly with Business Science Institute.
paragraphsRu: ICD - International Business School — французская Grande École de Commerce, основана в 1980 году, кампусы в Paris, Lyon и Toulouse. Входит в Groupe IGENSIA Education (бывшая Groupe IGS), один из крупнейших частных образовательных групп Франции. Programme Grande École выдаёт Bac+5 Diplôme Visé Grade de Master, признанный Министерством высшего образования Франции и labellisé Conférence des Grandes Écoles (CGE).

Флагман ICD — Bachelor en Sciences du Management, трёхлетняя программа со специализациями Business Development, Event Management и Marketing & AI. Линейка Mastère покрывает International Business Development, Ingénieur d'Affaires, Stratégies Digitales, Achats, Stratégies Commerciales du Luxe и Banque — с обязательной alternance в компаниях-партнёрах.

Международная мобильность — ядро программы: 80+ университетов-партнёров для семестрового обмена и отдельный Intercultural Management Semester (SMI) с маршрутами от Азии до Канады. Ежегодно более 100 стипендий Erasmus+ для студентов ICD на обмены и стажировки.

Парижский кампус Le Vivier расположен в составе IGENSIA Education campus в 10-м округе у Gare de l'Est. Международные абитуриенты поступают через Concours ICD или прямую заявку с IELTS / TOEFL; англоязычные программы — Bachelor International Business & Marketing, Mastère International Business Development и Executive DBA совместно с Business Science Institute.
